mapper.select: SELECT ym, IFNULL(SUM(price), 0) AS price FROM ( SELECT DATE_FORMAT(out_time, '%Y-%m') AS ym, IFNULL(SUM(total_price), 0) AS price FROM erp_sale_out WHERE out_time >= #{beginTime} AND out_time < #{endTime} AND deleted = 0 GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(out_time, '%Y-%m') UNION ALL SELECT DATE_FORMAT(return_time, '%Y-%m') AS ym, -IFNULL(SUM(total_price), 0) AS price FROM erp_sale_return WHERE return_time >= #{beginTime} AND return_time < #{endTime} AND deleted = 0 GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(return_time, '%Y-%m') ) monthly_price GROUP BY ym
